Rollback store modeled mutable row/events restored by doRollback; no MyBatis durable transaction proof
Loser finish and real lease expiry race after held() check not independently exercised; callback lock is coordination not atomic external fence

recommendation: Bind receipt/cleanup and lease/close release to real TransactionSynchronization.afterCommit and appropriate rollback recovery, or enforce verified independent REQUIRES_NEW terminal transaction contract. Preserve seq/text restoration and avoid releasing ownership before actual commit.
